dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Waxay dhab ahaan u fiicnay, qofkii ugu muhiimna waa macalimiisii.
dialogue.translation: It was very good, the most important person is the director.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Haddii ay ku jiraan macalimiis ku fiican, maxaa heerka?
dialogue.translation: If there is a good director, what about the story?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Heerka waxay dhexdhexaad u fiicnay, laakiin macalimiisii baa ugu fiican.
dialogue.translation: The story was average, but the director is the best.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Maalinba waxaan ku fiicnay in la ogaado heerka ku dhex jira.
dialogue.translation: Sometimes I like to know the story in between.

key_phrases.phrase: Maxaa heerka filmka?
key_phrases.translation: What is the story of the film?

key_phrases.phrase: Waxay dhab ahaan u fiicnay.
key_phrases.translation: It was very good.

dialogue.text: Maxaa haystaad ka qabatay shaqadaad la dhinac ka hor?
dialogue.translation: What did you learn from your previous job?

dialogue.speaker: Candidate
dialogue.text: Waxaan ka qaatay dhammaan waxyaabaha oo kala duwan.
dialogue.translation: I learned all the different things.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.text: Maalmool baad jeer uun shaqaysaa dhex team?
dialogue.translation: How often do you work in a team?

dialogue.speaker: Candidate
dialogue.text: Anigu waan jeer u shaqeyaa dhex team oo fiican.
dialogue.translation: I usually work well in a team.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.text: Maxaa haystaad uun qabatay qof ku salaysan?
dialogue.translation: What did you achieve as a leader?

dialogue.speaker: Candidate
dialogue.text: Waxaan qaatay dhammaan goal-kii aan ku qaatay.
dialogue.translation: I achieved all the goals I set.

dialogue.text: Miyii ku hufan tahay ka dhab aad uun u jeeddo?
